entities.context: L. Jiang, L. Chen, and Z. Chen, “Knowledge base enhancement via data facts and crowdsourcing,” in 2018 IEEE 34th International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE), 2018, pp. 1109–1119.

relationships.context: KG-aware FSL methods utilize structured data for knowledge graph completion models.
The paper reviews research for both Zero-shot and Few-shot Learning, highlighting the connections between the two.
All the auxiliary information used in ZSL can also be used in FSL, and the utilization method can be transferred to FSL easily
These methods are often used for multi-label classification where one sample is annotated by multiple related classes.
Meta learning is based on the idea of transfer learning, where a model learns to learn from past experiences.
KGs can be used to represent structured data, such as ontologies and databases.
The mapping learning of the class encoding impacts the mapping learning of the input encoding.
The performance of few-shot text classification is measured using knowledge graph completion models.
